zara-muse.alt: A painting in thick palette knife strokes of a woman in profile, seen from behind, with long dark hair and bare shoulders against a deep blue background.

konn-artiss.alt: A square artwork in collage and paint. A large glossy black disc with the name Konn Artiss in white capital letters sits over a collage of torn printed paper and thick strokes of yellow, red, black and pale peach paint.

banksy.alt: A dark statue seen from below against a grey sky: a man in a suit strides off the edge of a stone plinth while a large flag he holds blows back over his face, with scaffolded buildings behind.
banksy.caption: Statue by Banksy in Waterloo Place, London, installed in April 2026. Photographed in May 2026. Photo: Bex Walton, CC BY 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons.

yayoi-kusama.alt: Close view of Yayoi Kusama's face, with dark hair, red lipstick and pale pink glasses in a decorative silver frame.
yayoi-kusama.caption: Yayoi Kusama, around 2004. A still from George Quasha's film series art is (Speaking Portraits). Photo: George Quasha, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons.

el-anatsui.alt: A weathered grey stone sculpture of a crouching, rounded figure whose large hands cover its face, set on paving in front of a yellow concrete building.
el-anatsui.caption: Ambivalent Hold, from a design by El Anatsui, carved by the SKEP art collective for the Physical Sciences building at the University of Nigeria, Nsukka. Photographed in 2024. Photo: Mercyjamb123, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons.

s-h-raza.alt: S.H. Raza, an elderly man with white hair and glasses in a pale suit, seated and leaning over a sheet of paper as people gather close around him.
s-h-raza.caption: S.H. Raza at an art summit in Delhi, January 2011. Photo: Chetan Nikam, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons.

gerhard-richter.alt: Portrait of Gerhard Richter, an older man with white hair, a short white beard and round dark glasses, in a dark coat, looking at the camera.
gerhard-richter.caption: Gerhard Richter at the National Gallery, Prague, in April 2017. Photo: Jindřich Nosek (NoJin), CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons.
